# Bilal Arshad — Senior Full-Stack Developer

> Bilal Arshad is a senior full-stack developer with 8+ years of experience in PHP/Laravel, Node.js/NestJS, Next.js, React and Vue.js. He builds multi-vendor marketplaces, payment integrations (Moyasar, Stripe, PayPal), ZATCA (Fatoora) e-invoicing for Saudi Arabia, high-traffic streaming platforms, and production AI agents with LangGraph and FastAPI. Based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia; open to relocation.

- Current role: Senior Full Stack Developer at Tamakan (Jun 2026 – present), leading the Keeld marketplace and payments platform (NestJS, Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Flutter APIs).
- Previous: Lead Software Developer at Altadefinizione (2024–2026) — Laravel/Vue streaming platform serving 2.4M+ users; Redis caching cut load time from 2s to 120ms.
- Education: BS Software Engineering, COMSATS University Islamabad (Lahore campus), 2020.
- Contact: bilalarshad2088@gmail.com · WhatsApp +966 58 071 2710 · https://www.linkedin.com/in/bilalarshadramay/

- [NestJS developer](https://bilalarshad.pro/nestjs-developer/): NestJS + Prisma + PostgreSQL backends, payments, settlements

- [ZATCA e-invoicing developer](https://bilalarshad.pro/zatca-e-invoicing-developer/): Fatoora integration in custom platforms
- [Moyasar payment integration](https://bilalarshad.pro/moyasar-payment-integration/): cards, STC Pay, webhooks, refunds, reconciliation
